LIGHT WORK-CLASS / 500 M

R-150

Payload and thrust for tasks beyond a camera.

A 195 kg light work-class ROV rated to 500 m, with a 20 kg payload and modular interfaces for sensors and tools on offshore and hydraulic-structure tasks.

Configuration checks

  • Plan crane or A-frame launch and recovery, deck space and handling crew.
  • Confirm tool interfaces, hydraulic or electrical supply and the effect on trim.
  • Check tether length and drag against current and working depth.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

The manufacturer describes stable operation in sea state 4 and modular tool interfaces; confirm the test conditions and the specific tools offered for the supplied version. Sonar is an optional item purchased separately. The complete system includes the tether management system, control station and power supply.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle and installed payload
  • Control station and software functions
  • Tether length, reel and power supply
  • Selected tools, sensors and deployment equipment
  • Transport cases, spares, manuals and training

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.

Browse ROV tools & accessories

QUESTIONS

Before you specify the R-150.

Is the R-150 suitable for offshore wind or oil and gas work?

The manufacturer lists offshore wind cable, platform and pipeline applications. Owner requirements, inspection standards and deployment vessels differ by project, so suitability is assessed per project rather than assumed.

What is needed to deploy it?

At 195 kg the vehicle needs mechanical launch and recovery, deck or quayside space, power and a trained crew. Confirm the full system weight and footprint in the quotation.
